title: The Midwife's Debt
summary: The Midwife you spared sends word: she wants to undo what she poured. She needs ash.

dialogue.intro: She says none of them ever spoke. She says she's sorry.
dialogue.reward: She cried when I gave her your answer.
offer: She says none of them ever spoke. She says she's sorry.
Six. To sweeten the wells she soured. Kill something standing in blood with a bone blade and it leaves ash.
